Ūrdhvapuṇḍradhāraṇa
BORI. 28 of 1902-07. MT. 3554 (c) (fol.. 88a-93b; found along with Hārītasmṛti). Oppert I. 3950. II. 38.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍravastradhāraṇaviṣaya

Ūrdhvapuṇḍravicāra

Ūrdhvapuṇḍravijaya
śrīvaiṣ. by Campakeśācārya, son an. disciple of Varadācārya of [Page002-b] Kauśikagotra. mentioned in a.'s own Vādārthamālā, MT. 5111.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍravidhi
vaiṣ. on putting the religious mark on forehead; different texts, metrical an. otherwise.
Adyar I. p. 88a (Dvādaśaº). p. 107a. Gough p. 181. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 13 (3 mss.). MD. 2835. 2836. 2837 (has only 6(1/2) verses of Ū. p. dhāraṇa mantra dhyāna). 5212. 18381. MT. 660 (j). 4093 (d) (on fol.. 21a-22b). PUL. II. p. 37. Taylor I. 100. 133. TD. 13990 (inc.). XX. Sup. no. 1022.
--from the Kriyādīpikā. Taylor I. 287.
--from Vedāntadeśika's Saccaritrarakṣā. Taylor I. 183.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍrastotra
Burnell 110b.
--from Umāmaheśvarasaṁvāda of Nṛsiṁhapurāṇa. IO. 8093.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍra(dhāraṇa)upaniṣad
Adyar D. I. 315. MT. 352b. Trav. Uni. 1031Q. 1458D. 9868A. See below different Up. texts with similar names.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍropaniṣad
on the wearing of the sacred white earth on the forehead an. limbs; sometimes called also Varāhopaniṣad because of the text being a dialogue between Varāha an. Sanatkumāra. Adyar Up. p.. 148. 272. MD. 785-6. 17169 (somewhat shorter an. called Varāhopaniṣad). Mysore I. p. 10. Mysore D. I. 227. 446. Prativādibhayaṅkar p. 11 (no. 4).
Pt.. Adyar, Unpublished Up.. p.. 63-4.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍropaniṣad
otherwise called Vāsudevopaniṣad; another text similar to the above; dialogue between Lord Vāsudeva an. Nārada. IO. 491 (12). 493-4 (74). MD. 787-790. Mysore D. I. 228. 448-51. Oxf. II. 1008 (1c). [Page003-a.
See under Gopīcandanopaniṣad an. Vāsudevopaniṣad. Pt.. under the title Vāsudevopaniṣad in Jacob's edn. of Eleven Āth. Up.. p.. 25-34 an. N. S. Press publication of 120 Up.., p.. 405-7; an. under the title Vāsudevopaniṣad, in Adyar edn. Vaiṣṇavopaniṣads, p.. 375-382 an. with difference in the latter part an. under the title Gopīcandanopaniṣad in Adyar publication, Unpublished Up.. p.. 65-69. These two texts agree in the former half but differ in the latter. See also under Gopīcandanopaniṣad.

Ūrdhvapuṇḍropaniṣad
or zvetamRttiko(mRtsno)paniSad another text on same subject; a dialogue between Nārada an. Brahman. Adyar Up. p.. 28. 286. Mysore I. p. 10. Mysore D. I. 225-226.

Ūrdhvapurāṇa
Q. in the Vākyaratnākara of Govinda, son of Sadāśiva Miśra; earlier than 1550 A. D. (?) RASB. III. 2799. See also JASB. XX. I. p. 36.

Ūrdhvamukhanakṣatrāṇi
jy. Adyar II. p. 53a.

Ūrdhvamūla
Oppert II. 39 (dh.).
--by Vedavyāsa. Pejawar 321b.

Ūrdhvaśyāmāditantra
ref. to in Dattātreyatantra. Nepal II. p. 117-two titles, Ūrdhva tantra an. Śyāmā tantra ?.

Ūrdhvasārasaṃhitā
mantra-tantra. ref. to by Yadunātha Cakravartin in Mantraratnākara. RASB. VIII. A. 6192.

Ūrdhvāmnāya
tantra. Adyar II. p. 108b (Siddhāgama). B. IV. 254. Bhr. 394. C.. (3 mss.; in the third, the 10th ch., Vaiṣṇavavargagaṇana is missing). Kavīndrācārya 1761. Ramsingh 1088. RASB. VIII. A. 5962 (inc.). Stein 228 (?). Tagore 81 (Paṭalas 1 & 2). TCD. 1574D. Trav. Uni. C. 462D. Ref. to by Yadunātha Cakravartin in Mantraratnā- [Page003-b] kara, RASB. VIII. A. 6192; in Kulārṇavatantra, Oxf. 91a; in Śaktiratnākara, Oxf. 101b; in Śāktānandataraṅgiṇī, Oxf. 103v; in Prāṇatoṣiṇī, p. 2.

Ūrdhvāmnāya
probably the vaiṣ. saṁhitā.
--Rādhikākṛpākaṭākṣa stotra from. IM. 8729. Varendra 1130.

Ūrdhvāmnāyatantra
called more fully Kālyūrdhvāmnāya tantra ascribed to Mahādeva. C.. V. 22. Dacca D. R. 83. 1561. B. (inc.). L. 1743. RASB. VIII. A. 5963. Tagore 71 (Paṭala 5). Vaṅgīya p. 28 (inc.).

Ūrdhvāmnāyatantra
assigned to the Kulārṇava tantra (?) Dacca 247.

Ūrdhvāmnāyatantre
--Antaryajana. Dacca 2224A. 2224B.
--Gurupādukāpañcakastotra. RASB. VIII. B. 6799.
--Bāhyamātṛkānyāsa. L. 356.
--Mahāṣoḍhānyāsa. BBRAS. 863. L. 356.

Ūrdhvāmnāyanyāsa
Adyar II. p. 184a.

Ūrdhvāmnāyapaddhati
one of the four parts of the Āmnāyapaddhati. See NCC. II. p. 147b.

Ūrdhvāmnāyapīṭhapūjanavidhāna
tantra. Radh. 25.

Ūrdhvāmnāyapurāṇa
see also under Ūrdhvāmnāya Saṁhitā, vaiṣ.

Ūrdhvāmnāyamantra
Adyar II. p. 215b. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 13 (2 mss.).

Ūrdhvāmnāyasaṃhitā
also called Ū. ā. purāṇa; vaiṣ.; interlocution between Nārada an. Vyāsa; 12 chs.; deals with Caitanya a. a. incarnation of Lord Viṣṇu.
Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 18 (2 mss.). AS. p. 31. Dacca 254B. 1375. 3531. Filliozat I. 199. 200. L. 243. MT. 3053 (a-34). Oxf. 301b. RASB. VIII. A. 5959. 5960 (inc.). 5961 (inc.). SK. [Page004-a. Ray 226. Vaṅgīya p. 28 (inc.). Vaṅgīya Sup. 1688.
